concept: Tactical Organic / The Performance Pro mixed with Earthy

headings.style: tracking-tight, highly legible, strong character for premium tactical feel.

textures.hero_background: Topographic map SVG pattern at 3% opacity overlaid on the background.

marketing.hero: Asymmetric Bento Grid (Grid Mode A) with high impact typography and dark/tactical image overlays.
marketing.features: Alternating grid with sticky content sections.

app_shell.structure: Fixed left sidebar (desktop) / Bottom sheet or Hamburger (mobile) + Top Header with breadcrumbs/profile.
app_shell.content_area: Max-width container, dense data layout (Grid Mode B).
app_shell.spacing: Tight to moderate (p-4, p-6, gap-4, gap-6)

grids.bento_dashboard: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 or gap-6. Summary cards col-span-1, primary charts col-span-2 or 3, tall lists col-span-1 row-span-2.
grids.bento_marketing: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-8 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-8 or gap-12.

components_strategy.buttons: Sharp/Slightly rounded (radius_md). Primary buttons use brand terracotta (#E25822) with hover brightness increase. Secondary buttons use ghost/outline.
components_strategy.cards: Cardless or Neumorphism flat solid surface with 1px border. No soft massive shadows on dashboards.
components_strategy.navigation: Sidebar with Phosphor Icons (technical, crisp). Active state highlighted with brand color left border.
components_strategy.inputs: Shadcn based. Flat background, sharp borders, clear focus rings (ring-primary/30).
components_strategy.maps: Leaflet.js map with CartoDB Dark Matter or customized Mapbox dark style for Trip Planner.

motion.interactions: Hover states on all cards (border color change, subtle -translate-y-0.5).
motion.page_transitions: Framer motion fade and slight upward drift.
motion.lists: Staggered entrance animations for Feed, Logs, and Garage lists.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure primary text meets 4.5:1. Button text is white on #E25822.
accessibility.focus: Clear focus rings on all interactive elements.
accessibility.testing: Use data-testid on all key interactive elements (e.g., 'login-submit-button', 'add-bike-button').

media_and_3d.icons: @phosphor-icons/react (Duotone or Regular weight for technical feel)
media_and_3d.3d_libraries: Not explicitly required, but Recharts should be used for Statistics.

marketing_hero.description: Group of people riding motorcycle on road (adventure/touring feel)

marketing_feature_1.description: Two motorcyclists riding down a country road

garage_empty_state.description: A person holding/working on a car/bike engine

trip_planner_map_overlay.description: Overhead view of a map with a compass

stats_background.description: Flat lay of a map with compasses

instructions_to_main_agent: Use Tailwind CSS for styling. Implement both light and dark themes using CSS variables, but design dark mode as the primary focus.
Initialize Shadcn UI for standard components using .js/.jsx extensions (e.g., no TypeScript, use Javascript).
Build standard layouts: Marketing page (HTML+Tailwind, no Shadcn wrappers), App Shell (Sidebar+Header for authenticated views).
Build the dashboard bento grid accurately. Ensure cards have 1px borders and distinct surfaces.
For the Trip Planner, integrate a Leaflet map (e.g., using react-leaflet) to show routes and waypoints.
Build charts using Recharts for the Statistics page and Fuel trends.
Apply topographic SVG background patterns to empty states and hero sections.
Do NOT use 'Inter' for headings. Ensure 'Outfit' and 'Manrope' fonts are properly imported and applied.
Ensure the Garage uses the provided motorcycle image URLs for primary bike cards.
Ensure all buttons, inputs, and list items have appropriate hover and focus states.
Include 'data-testid' attributes on all clickable elements.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.avoid_ai_slop: Do not make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling. Use asymmetrical grids when possible.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.depth: Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and subtle glass-morphism.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.transitions: NEVER apply 'transition: all'. Apply transitions specific to properties (e.g., transition-colors, transition-transform).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.alignment: Do NOT center align the app container. Respect optical alignment.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.icons: NEVER use AI assistant emojis. Use the specified icon library (@phosphor-icons/react).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.spacing: Use 2-3x more spacing in marketing sections than feels necessary.
